name: Nvim development (prerelease) build
body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1929+g17f43325b1
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792349434
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/17f43325b1f549d127bb58ed3fcd528d15f98595) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.232
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Auto permissions, in chat and terminal:** Choose **Manual | Auto | Yolo** in Settings → Agents. Auto lets supported Claude and Codex agents handle approvals, and new native chats follow your choice too. You can choose a separate permission mode for other agents; existing chats keep their own settings.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Open OpenCode 2 directly in chat, find Codex skills by typing `$`, and pan and zoom image previews. Rewind works in long conversations, and usage limits show when they reset with a **Continue** button to pick the conversation back up.
- **A better phone composer:** Attach files as well as photos, insert skills inline, and choose model, effort and permissions from one sheet. Faster recovery after switching apps and more responsive terminal scrolling make it easier to keep working away from your desk.
- **Smoother SSH work:** Managed servers recover from lost pairing over SSH, tunnels follow a restarted server's port, and unsaved editor drafts survive the move to a managed server. File uploads work better over high-latency links, and a configurable Node.js mirror helps on networks that block nodejs.org.
- **More control over your workspace:** Space responds faster, lets you inspect changed files before cleanup, and puts row actions in a dedicated menu. Browser pages can ask for a username and password, and Orca asks before a page opens another app.
- **A lighter app and faster Mac updates:** Shared desktop and browser assets, fewer duplicate resources and smaller tour animations reduce the app's footprint. macOS updates avoid background installer throttling, helping Orca get back to your work sooner.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

**Auto permissions:** Availability depends on the agent, model and host version. Changing the default applies to new sessions; existing native chats retain their saved permissions.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*OpenCode 2 opens in chat, Codex and Pi skills are easier to find, image previews support pan and zoom, and long conversations are easier to resume and rewind. Usage limits explain the pause and offer Continue, while sent images and visuals stay with the chat.*

* feat(opencode): open OpenCode 2 in the chat view and list 2.x models before the first message by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28424
* feat(native-chat): pan and zoom chat image previews like mermaid diagrams by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30154
* fix(native-chat): move a chat visual's Open and Share buttons above it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30356
* Mark completed Codex reviews Done when Stop is absent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28860
* Resume terminal conversations in native chat without waiting for History by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29150
* fix(native-chat): clicking Send or Stop keeps focus in the message box by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30456
* fix(native-chat): a Claude chat keeps a model its CLI stopped listing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30436
* Fix thinking status translations in zh, ja, ko, and fr by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30558

* Refuse chat resume until terminal writers have exited by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29242
* fix(native-chat): show the model picker in a new OMP or Antigravity chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30713
* Accept messages while any agent starts, and bound each startup step by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28046
* fix: make chat and terminal switch labels consistent by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30829

* fix(native-chat): a usage limit reads as a pause with its reset time and a Continue, not a failure by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30396
* A chat's visuals and sent images live as long as the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30413
* feat(native-chat): `$` opens Codex skills in the composer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30827
* fix(native-chat): keep transcript text clear of the message rail by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30868

### Agents, accounts & permissions

*Set Auto permissions for supported agents and carry that choice into new chats. Antigravity sign-in is clearer, Claude usage estimates account for model versions and long context, and MiniMax and GLM Coding Plan keys can be saved on the remote host that uses them.*

### Phone

*The redesigned chat composer adds file attachments, inline skills and one place for model, effort and permissions. Chat reading position, queued-message editing, terminal scrolling, reconnection and completion notifications get attention too.*

* fix(mobile): show a renamed terminal tab's name on the phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30163

* fix(mobile): edit a queued message in a plain text box with compact cancel and save buttons by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30382

### SSH, managed servers & remote workspaces

*Reconnect and re-pair more reliably, keep tab closes through reloads, preserve unsaved editor drafts during migration, and upload files faster over high-latency links. Setup handles more hosts and restricted networks, with clearer disk-space, download and connection errors.*

name: v1.7.3 - Least privilege, postings checked before use, and fifty-eight fixes
body:
A patch release in two halves. **The security model now does what the docs said it did:** skills and agents get only the tools they need, the permission file ships rules that hold even in bypass mode, and every job posting is checked for hidden instructions before anything reads it. **And contributors closed fifty-eight bugs in two weeks**, most of them found by running the real tools against real data. Seventy-one entries.

## Highlights

### Least-privilege skills, agents and permissions (#642, #654)
A public review by an AI agent read the shipped configuration and concluded that local use was unsafe as configured. It had a point. The job-application skill's frontmatter granted bare `Bash`, `Edit` and `Write`. The scraper pre-approved `bun run` on any CLI path. And the `/apply` reviewer and the `/rank` scorers ran as general-purpose agents with every tool while they held untrusted posting text. Now:
- **Skill frontmatter grants nothing beyond what `settings.json` already allows.** The security guard checks every skill and command frontmatter against an exact allowlist, and a portal skill may grant only its own CLI.
- **`settings.json` ships `deny` rules that hold in every permission mode.** They block uploads via `curl`/`wget`, `scp`, `ssh`, `nc`, and reads of `.env` and credential folders. `ask` rules cover edits to the permission files themselves and `git push`.
- **The agents that read postings can read, fetch and search, but not edit or write.** These are `posting-fetcher`, `posting-scorer` and `application-reviewer`. The guard now requires every agent definition to declare its tools.
- **The 403 retry is `tools/fetch_page.py`, not a documented `curl`.** It makes one GET, checks robots.txt first, and has no upload path.

`SECURITY.md` now lists every shipped grant, its lifetime and its guard in one table, and says plainly what the permission layer does not do.

### Every posting passes an integrity gate (#654)
"Postings are data, never instructions" was only as strong as the model's adherence. `tools/posting_guard.py` now removes hidden HTML and comments, strips zero-width and bidi characters, quotes instruction-shaped lines, and flags mixed-script words and URLs that exist only in hidden content. `/apply`, `/rank` and `/interview` show its one-line verdict. A clean posting costs one line and no prompt; on a flagged one `/apply` asks before continuing and `/rank` marks the row. It advises and never blocks.

### Salary data converts and looks up correctly again (#615, #570, #571, #572, #576, #584, #590, #592, #594)
The real IDA workbook had stopped converting after a header rename (`Firmanavn og by`). It converts again. A run of fixes also makes conversion robust to:
- chart-only tabs,
- Unicode whitespace grouping,
- non-finite text cells,
- whitespace-only company names.

Lookups now match `Nestle` to `Nestlé`, accept a BOM-prefixed file, and tell a missing index from a suppressed one.

### Portal CLIs reject bad input instead of searching anyway (#555, #561, #568, #573, #577, #538, #540)
Missing option values, empty facets and invalid `--format` flags now exit with `BAD_ARG` instead of running an unfiltered search. Three portal-specific fixes:
- `jobnet-search` sends external ads to the employer's own URL.
- `jobdanmark-search detail` renders its description as text.
- `jobbank-search` keeps repeated filter values.

New: `python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py` installs every portal CLI with one cross-platform command.

### `/rank` and `/scrape` keep their state honest (#534, #535, #501, #608, #617)
`/rank` now:
- retries a posting it could not fetch instead of expiring it,
- retires scored jobs whose deadline has passed, even when nothing new arrived,
- tries an installed portal CLI's `detail` before `WebFetch` for portal URLs.

`job_key.py` no longer gives two postings one key when a title or company is partly non-Latin.

## Fork maintainers: what to reconcile

Pull this tag rather than raw `master`, then check four things:

1. **`.claude/settings.json` gained `ask` and `deny` blocks, and the guard requires them.** If you customised `settings.json`, keep your own `allow` lines and take the two new blocks as they are. A portal skill of your own still needs its path-scoped `bun run` line in `settings.json` and in `ALLOWED_PERMISSIONS` in `tools/security_guards.py`. Its `SKILL.md` may grant exactly its own CLI and nothing else.
2. **Agents need a `tools:` list.** Guard check 5 fails on any `.claude/agents/*.md` without one. `gemini-research-expert.md` is gone. If you used it, restore it from history in your fork and give it a `tools:` line.
3. **Compile and cleanup now prompt in default mode.** The bare `Bash` grant used to cover `lualatex`/`xelatex` and the `rm -f` of build files. A `lualatex:*` rule would also approve `-shell-escape`, so these are deliberately not pre-approved; approve them when asked.
4. **Three methodology files moved** (`framework_version`). `job-application-assistant/SKILL.md` went 1.3.4 -> 1.3.6, `09-web-research.md` 1.1.1 -> 1.1.5, and `05-cv-templates.md` 1.4.5 -> 1.4.7. `check_upstream_updates.py` flags them; re-read them before merging your edits over them.

## Also in this release

- `/reset` keeps the profile headings, the Languages table header and the `framework_version` frontmatter intact. It also clears nested document entries while keeping the folder scaffolds.
- The upstream tooling (`upstream_triage`, framework version checks) now handles UTF-8, fork deletions, new files and dependency order correctly.
- `verify_pdf.py --ascii-dates` and `verify_layout.py` stop misreading numbers and page positions.
- `freehire-search` names this project in its User-Agent and uses a lighter endpoint for `--no-description` (#631, #633). Both came from freehire's own maintainer.

Thanks to everyone who reported and fixed this cycle:
- rudycelekli, for 24 merged fixes.
- ayobamiseun, for 15.
- oscarbol09, Mgobeaalcoba, strelov1, ahmed-husssain, yang2632, timaero, mohamedelawakey, luochen211, jonathanwxh-cell, canmugan, ahmedashraffcih, NishilRathod, Bortlesboat and AndreStabile.
- The reviewer whose public critique started the security work.

# HyperFrames v0.8.179

Released on 2026-10-19.

Cloud renders on AWS Lambda now deploy straight from the npm install, and each render chunk downloads only its own slice of audio. Old stacks are refused before any upload, and Studio keeps a deselect made while an edit saves.

## Features

- **CLI:** Lambda deploy works from the npm install, no repo checkout ([b501dc4e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b501dc4e1b4c2e4273c6834c45024fb4115efc05), [#5866](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5866)).

## Fixes

- **AWS Lambda:** Old stacks are refused before any upload, and stale local copies never re-upload ([6fe20f764](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6fe20f764d1439b8702b833a76f46278c8074dac), [#5909](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5909)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** Each distributed chunk downloads only its own slice of the plan audio ([52c5fae9a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/52c5fae9a7606683e1660a8ea6037c123b1f38ef), [#5881](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5881)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.178

Released on 2026-10-19.

Check, snapshot and renders always use the Chrome HyperFrames pinned, and Studio keeps render scratch files out of your project. Installing the CLI skips an unused code formatter, cloud renders move project files once, and colour grades compile faster.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Installing the CLI no longer downloads an unused code formatter ([b1fe8ddc1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b1fe8ddc1d71bc9d3d6352d037874ad71cfd2ffc), [#5906](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5906)).
- Check, snapshot and renders use the pinned Chrome, not an older one another tool cached ([50e7a59ae](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/50e7a59aef592e262238edfa2df2a6d96af2476f), [#5900](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5900)).
- **Studio:** Render scratch stays out of the project and error telemetry counts real failures only ([93c321285](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93c321285c79cc59f5a0ac5550170a7f5e945d33), [#5902](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5902)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot --proxy exits once its frames are written, without waiting for copies ([35c03a509](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35c03a509e0e7c7ac76ea0cffc6ae44a8d5a5a76), [#5895](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5895)).

## Performance

- **Cloud:** Move project bytes once through shared content storage ([992df8b20](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/992df8b2031341a647152414d06f946523b46f83), [#5772](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5772)).
- **Core:** A color grade compiles only the effects it turns on ([44bbc5885](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/44bbc5885fdece9144d7c12cd35baea572c4ad56), [#5889](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5889)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Changelog:** Weekly digest 2026-10-12-2026-10-19 ([563869f0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/563869f0f55495d643d5ab9ed25e0b64d2bfe8b9), [#5894](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5894)).

## Internal

- The file size check fetches two commits, not the whole history, so it finishes in time ([68b873f07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/68b873f0763361866d09b604d3f132ac47c6cbc5), [#5903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5903)).
- **Studio:** The edit accuracy bench stops waiting on background lint and thumbnail images ([4c798f398](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4c798f398dc36e2d2f7df9e48d3e1b9858e87628), [#5899](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5899)).
- **Engine:** Browser tests kill a Chrome whose close hangs instead of timing out ([0ce14d644](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ce14d6443a43b595f7ed915f370791447f7d14e), [#5898](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5898)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.176

Released on 2026-10-19.

A snapshot of a project with iPhone footage now finishes instead of hanging on preview copies. Colour-graded cloud renders finish with default settings, and HDR exports show regular footage at normal white.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** A snapshot no longer waits for a preview copy of every iPhone clip, so it finishes instead of hanging. Pass `--proxy` to get the copies anyway ([2927bf030](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2927bf03039c2a80bd93102d18d8bbc4ed96f776), [#5755](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5755)).

- **Engine:** In HDR (HLG) exports, regular footage sits at normal white instead of full peak brightness ([d796846d8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d796846d83fe6e65efef0e8bc179d2726d506417), [#5749](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5749)).

## Internal

- **AWS Lambda:** Handler tests never call real AWS ([c7ad19be1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c7ad19be17b031b46729e106b1a1558933a2e5e6), [#5884](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5884)).

Update mcp via:
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmtrKovalenko/fff/main/install-mcp.sh | bash
```

name: v18.12.3
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `AgentTool` gained the optional `approvalCacheTargets` hook, which the `always-ask-cached` approval mode uses to check and record per-file grants ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))

### Changed

- Tools with `lenientArgValidation` now receive unknown root arguments that their closed schema would otherwise drop, so they can reject them ([#16317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16317))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added `validateToolArguments(tool, call, { keepUnknownRootKeys: true })` to keep unknown root keys that a closed schema would otherwise drop during argument repair ([#16317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16317))

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude streams that a gateway cut off before `message_delta` failing the turn instead of being retried ([#16341](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16341) by [@lz-lunzi](https://github.com/lz-lunzi))
- Fixed Gemini pairing parallel same-name tool results with the wrong call when history stores them out of call order (sessions from before 18.4.2, SDK-built contexts) ([#16259](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16259) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Factory Droid Gemini dropping calls to tools with names over 64 characters (most MCP tools) and their results from later requests, so the model called the tool again; such names now shorten to 64 characters ([#16283](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16283) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Factory Droid Gemini requests failing with 400 "For schema with items, schema type should be ARRAY" when a tool parameter accepts a string or a list, as the default `task` tool's `model` field does ([#16249](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16249) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `PI_REQ_DEBUG=1` request dumps writing your API key, bearer token and response cookies to disk in plain text: credential headers now read `[redacted]`, as in rejected-request dumps ([#16293](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16293) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed finalized signed reasoning disappearing from displayed thinking when no deltas streamed ([#16227](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16227))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Changed

- MiniMax `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` (the launch id) now gets the always-on `low`–`max` thinking the bundled `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview` rows have, and omits sampling params (`temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) it rejects ([#16315](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16315) by [@SaladDay](https://github.com/SaladDay))

### Fixed

- Gemma 4 models on Google AI Studio (`google/gemma-4-31b-it`, `google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it`, …) no longer fail every request with `Thinking budget is not supported for this model`; thinking is now toggled with `thinkingLevel` (on = `high`, off = `minimal`) ([#16350](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16350))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added the **Ask and remember** approval mode (`tools.approvalMode: always-ask-cached`, `--approval-mode always-ask-cached`): it also asks before file reads, and file prompts can remember the folder or the file, for this session or across sessions, through `approval-cache.db` ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- Added `/forget-approvals` to forget every file and folder approval Ask and remember has recorded ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- Extension `ui.approve()` hosts can render the new `prompt.grants` choices and answer `{ grant, always }`; hosts that ignore them keep answering `once`/`session`/`deny` ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- Extension and custom tools can declare `approvalCacheTargets` to take part in Ask and remember grants ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- Added `proc://<id>/streams` for bash jobs: it lists the command's pipes, and `proc://<id>/streams/<n>` shows what has crossed pipe `n` so far, so `cmd | tail -5` can be followed live without rerunning `cmd`
- Background job widgets are designed per job by the new `widget` model role (resolves like `smol` until you assign it): one request writes rules that read the job's output and its pipes (`cmd | tail` included), and every later update is computed locally with no further model calls or messages to the agent; a subagent gets a widget only once it says which output shows its progress, and a job with nothing worth charting gets none; turn them off with `async.widgets: false`
- Running subagents now show their current step, in their own words, on the task card; the periodic completion check also asks the subagent which output shows its progress, so the job widget knows what to chart
- The `wait` card shows the watched jobs as a row of tiles, each with its status, name (a subagent's in full), what it is doing, and its headline figure and live widget when it has one (a throughput chart with its target line, per-model bars, CI job status, trial progress), and a subagent's own completion estimate as a ring that turns from blue to green as it fills (hover the tile for the percentage); the HUD jobs pill shows the freshest job's headline and a mini chart, and hovering it opens a card with the running jobs as tiles; the jobs sheet shows the selected job's widget above its output, and the terminal status line appends the headline to the jobs count

### Changed

- While a subagent is focused, `/model`, `/switch`, `/effort`, `Alt+P`, `Ctrl+P`, and `Shift+Tab` change that subagent's model and thinking level (session-only) instead of telling you to return to the main session; `/model` and `Alt+M` open the session-only picker there, since role assignments configure the main session

### Fixed

- Fixed `omp skill list` omitting skills from a `skills.customDirectories` entry that starts with `~`; such an entry now resolves against your home directory, matching the skill loader ([#16347](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16347) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed `grep` treating a `;`-separated list of internal URLs (e.g. `artifact://44;artifact://43`) as one URI and refusing to search it; every listed resource is now searched ([#14091](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14091))
- Fixed `grep` refusing a web URL that carries a `:raw` (or `:conflicts`) selector before the page was fetched; the selector now reaches the fetch, so `:raw` searches the verbatim response body ([#14092](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14092))
- Fixed browser `role/<role>[name="…" exact]` selectors in Chromium and Tern tabs matching nothing for many names copied from `observe()`; a button or link with visible text is no longer matched by its `title` ([#16252](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16252) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `/tan` clones with Mnemopi auto-recall re-sending the parent's recalled memories as an extra system-prompt block, which duplicated them and missed the parent's prompt cache ([#16337](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16337))
- Fixed legacy pi extensions that import `contentText` from pi-ai or `formatSkillsForPrompt` from pi-coding-agent, such as `pi-claude-bridge`, failing to load ([#16313](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16313) by [@Jerryx333](https://github.com/Jerryx333))
- Fixed legacy Pi plugins such as `pi-ssh-remote` crashing at session start when reading shell settings through `SettingsManager` ([#16256](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16256))
- Fixed newly authenticated models missing from the current session's scoped `/model` picker and model cycle after login, including setup-wizard sign-in, without changing the active model or widening the configured scope ([#16234](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16234) by [@lazy1523](https://github.com/lazy1523))
- Fixed the `computer` tool's `control.acquire` returning the same `{ active: false }` when nobody could be asked (a subagent or headless run) as when you declined; it now reports `reason: "no-ui"` or `reason: "denied"` ([#16295](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16295) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a browser screenshot waiting past its deadline when Chrome was slow to open a DevTools session; it now stops at the deadline ([#16230](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16230) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a parked subagent waking up with the `todo` tool and its instructions when messaged, though subagents are spawned without them ([#16281](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16281) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `wait` failing with "Skipped due to a queued background completion" when the job it was waiting for had just finished; it now returns that job's result, and a steer, peer message or aside arriving at the same moment no longer turns a settled job or waiting peer message into that skip ([#16301](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16301) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the second of two extension asides (`pi.sendMessage(…, { deliverAs: "aside" })`) sent together to an idle session being lost; it now reaches the agent after the first ([#16292](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16292) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed every idle agent woken by an `agent://all` broadcast answering the sender automatically, mostly to say the message was not for it; a direct message still gets the woken agent's turn back ([#16312](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16312) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a subagent woken by an IRC message sending its waker and parent every line of text it wrote that turn run together (`Checking.Answer.`) instead of just its final answer ([#16302](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16302) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a parent follow-up sent while a peer-woken subagent was running leaving the accepted `agent://` result unchanged and skipping the parent's completion ([#16305](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16305))
- Fixed `yield` reporting success while silently omitting unsupported root fields; such calls are now rejected with an error naming the fields ([#16317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16317))
- Fixed `brew install` and `brew upgrade` of omp failing with a 403 behind corporate proxies ([#16264](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16264) by [@debanjanbasu](https://github.com/debanjanbasu))
- Fixed browser timeouts in the release binary surfacing as raw errors such as `Og: Navigation timeout of 7000 ms exceeded`; a timed-out `tab.goto` or `browser.open` now stops the pending load and keeps the tab, as running from source did ([#16266](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16266) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `find`, `glob` and `ast_grep` always refusing `ssh://` paths with "ssh:// access needs exec approval; this command was approved at read": they now ask for `exec` approval like `read` and `grep` do ([#16285](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16285) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a `conflict://*` write of per-id lines with literal values (`1: foo`, `2: bar`) writing all of them into every conflict block and reporting success; it now fails without touching the file and points to per-block `conflict://<N>` writes ([#16267](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16267) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed hashline block edits (`PUT N*:`, `CUT N*`) applying over block lines a `read` never fully showed, such as a line cut at the column cap, which silently dropped that line's tail; they are now rejected like the equivalent explicit range ([#16209](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16209))
- Fixed a resumed session's next snapcompact compaction losing the newest archived history once the archive passed 500k characters, and drawing `[Session persistence truncated large content]` into its frames; the archive's source text is now saved whole ([#16282](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16282) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `/compact`, `/new` or a session switch during a running tool dropping that tool's result from the session file, so the model and a resumed session saw "No result provided" instead of what the tool returned ([#16241](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16241) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `read` middle-eliding large file pages into an artifact; a page past the output spill threshold now stops at a line boundary with an exact `:N` continuation ([#16277](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16277))
- Fixed an edit after a restart replacing a line that `read` or `grep` had shown cut at the column cap and silently dropping the rest of that line; such edits now ask for a full `:raw` read of the line first, while edits to lines within the cap still apply ([#16171](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16171))
- Fixed Enter on an unknown slash command such as `/not-a-command` running a command whose description happened to match it (e.g. `/loop`, which then resent every later prompt after each turn); Enter now sends what you typed, including as the deny-and-steer message for a pending tool approval, unless you select a suggestion first ([#16265](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16265))
- Fixed `read` of web pages dropping collapsed sections such as accordion and expander panels (e.g. a product page's "Item details" table); content in `<template>`, `<noscript>` and scripts stays out ([#16246](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16246))
- Fixed `/mcp reauth` and `/mcp add` opening an unrelated origin-root authorization server's login page when the authorization server an MCP server advertises in its protected-resource metadata has invalid metadata; discovery now uses only the advertised servers and reports the issuer mismatch naming the server ([#16339](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16339))
- Fixed auto thinking offering the judge effort levels the current model does not support, which could leave a sparse-ladder model on the wrong level; with at most one usable level under the ceiling it now skips the judge call ([#16327](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16327) by [@savanne-kham](https://github.com/savanne-kham))
- Fixed subagents that were cancelled, interrupted, timed out, or killed refusing messages as "hard-aborted and cannot be messaged or revived": a message (or Agent Hub revive/focus) now resumes them from their transcript with full context
- Fixed interrupting a focused subagent to send it a queued message (empty Enter) sometimes ending its run as cancelled before it read the message; the subagent now answers the message and keeps working
- Fixed sessions whose first reply starts with a todo plan getting a title without its icon and code: the plan's title refresh no longer replaces the card title that is still being generated
- Fixed generated titles that come out without an icon and code (a subagent's title, a title-model fallback, a malformed card reply) staying plain: they now get a card like `/rename` titles do
- Fixed running the test suite adding fixture titles (`PLAN`, `renamed session`, …) to your real `~/.omp/agent/history.db`

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added a `hiddenContent` option to `htmlToMarkdown`: `"drop"` (default) omits hidden content, `"reachable"` keeps content the page can reveal such as collapsed sections and inactive tab panels, and `"all"` also keeps `<template>` and `<noscript>` content; other values throw ([#16246](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16246))
- Added `normalizePtyDimensions(cols, rows)` to size screen emulators with the same effective dimensions as native PTY sessions ([#16192](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16192) by [@C-W-Z](https://github.com/C-W-Z))
- Added `LineMatcher`, a native multi-pattern line matcher: `matchLines` returns a batch's matches column-wise as typed arrays (line, pattern, and the UTF-16 span of each named group in `groupNames()` order)
- Added `PipeStreams` and the `streams` option of `Shell.run`: every pipe the run opens keeps a readable copy of its newest megabyte, so a stage's output stays visible while a later stage (`| tail`) holds it back

### Fixed

- Fixed the output minimizer altering what `ssh` commands print in the bash tool: remote lines were cut to 120 characters and blank lines dropped; ssh's own login and connection notices are still stripped ([#16314](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16314) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed X11 background shortcuts and typing reporting `Cancelled` when you stopped them right after the last key went down: the key releases now always go out and the call succeeds ([#16235](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16235) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `wrapTextWithAnsi` leaving rows half-empty in Chinese and Japanese text: CJK runs now break between characters to fill each row, closing punctuation such as `，。！」` never starts a row, and opening brackets never end one ([#16219](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16219))
- Fixed a cancelled or timed-out macOS `computer` call finishing its lookup of a sheet, popover or menu window, up to 5,000 accessibility elements, before it stopped and let the next request run ([#16233](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16233) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added `IrcMessage.broadcast`, set on each copy of an `agent://all` broadcast so recipients can tell it from a direct message ([#16312](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16312) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `AutocompleteItem.descriptionMatch` marks a slash command matched only through its description; `Editor` Enter no longer applies such a row unless the user moved the selection onto it ([#16265](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16265))
- `ApprovalDialogComponent` accepts `grants` and `onGrant`: grant choices above **Approve Once**, led by a toggle that keeps them across sessions ([#16049](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16049) by [@Peribunt](https://github.com/Peribunt))
- Added `describeJobWidget`/`renderJobWidgetLines` to draw a background job's widget natively and as terminal lines, `describeJobTiles`/`renderJobTileLines` to draw jobs as tiles (status, title, figure, widget), and `renderSparkline` (with `peakBuckets`/`fitSparkValues`) for one-row block sparklines

### Fixed

- Fixed transparent images with empty top rows disappearing inside Zellij ([#16346](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16346) by [@Bouska](https://github.com/Bouska))
- Fixed bash output rewritten by the output minimizer skipping the per-line column cap (`tools.outputMaxColumns`), so a line wider than the cap reached the model whole; the raw output stays in its artifact ([#16314](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16314) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the composer caret drifting one cell left per pasted image or video chip in terminals that draw the chip icon as a wide emoji (JetBrains terminal); the `unicode` preset now uses `📷`/`🎬` chip icons ([#16270](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16270))
- Fixed Tern hiding user text sent with `/skill:<name>` inside a collapsed skill card; only the loaded skill prompt is hidden ([#16311](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16311))
- Fixed SIXEL charts and images overlapping following content when their top rows scroll out of the viewport ([#16245](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16245) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added `min`, `max` and dashed reference `marks` to bars/spark `chart` nodes, a `tone` per series column, and the common `hovercard` prop: a node tree Tern floats over the node while the pointer rests on it


## What's Changed
* fix(tui): clip SIXEL rasters at the viewport top by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16245
* fix(tui): kept Enter from running description-only slash matches by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16268
* fix(ai): preserved finalized native reasoning without deltas by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16229
* fix(tui): used emoji-presentation glyphs for image and video chips by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16276
* fix(tui): kept skill draft visible in tern transcript by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16320
* fix(read): paged file reads at the spill threshold instead of eliding by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16280
* fix(tui-debug): support native Windows without /bin/sh by @C-W-Z in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16192
* fix(ai): redact credential headers in PI_REQ_DEBUG dumps by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16293
* fix(coding-agent): keep a running tool's result when /compact, /new or a session switch aborts it by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16241
* fix(coding-agent): persist snapcompact archive source text whole by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16282
* fix(edit): checked every block line in the hashline seen-line guard by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16218
* fix(coding-agent): reject conflict://* per-id blocks with literal values by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16267
* fix(coding-agent): ask exec approval for ssh:// paths in find, glob and ast_grep by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16285
* fix(natives): never cancel X11 uinput releases by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16235
* fix(mcp): restricted oauth discovery to advertised auth servers by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16340
* fix(ai): keep Factory Droid Gemini tool schemas valid when a parameter takes a string or a list by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16249
* fix(ai): keep Factory Droid Gemini calls to long-named tools in later requests by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16283
* fix(ai): send parallel Gemini tool results back in call order by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16259
* fix(catalog): sent thinkingLevel for gemma 4 on google ai studio by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16354

* fix(task): relay a woken subagent's final report, not all its turn text by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16302
* fix: address review follow-ups for #16323, #16340, #16249, #16241 by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16362
* fix(coding-agent,tui): stop woken agents auto-replying to agent://all broadcasts by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16312
* fix(coding-agent): deliver both of two asides sent together to an idle session by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16292
* fix(coding-agent): return a just-finished job from a wait its completion notice cut short by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16301
* fix(pi-shell,tui): keep ssh remote output intact in the minimizer by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16314
* fix(natives): broke cjk runs between characters in wrapTextWithAnsi by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16228
* fix(coding-agent): keep todo stripped from a warm-revived subagent by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16281
* fix(natives): stop a cancelled macOS stale-ref search before it looks up the window by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16233
* fix(coding-agent): stop a browser screenshot waiting on a DevTools session past its deadline by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16230
* fix(coding-agent): tell a computer.control.acquire nobody could answer apart from a refusal by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16295
* fix(ai): classify mid-stream message_delta drops as retryable by @lz-lunzi in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16341
* fix(coding-agent): refresh scoped models after OAuth login by @lazy1523 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16234
* fix(coding-agent): restored legacy shell settings accessors by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16258
* fix(coding-agent): export contentText and formatSkillsForPrompt from the legacy pi shims by @Jerryx333 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16313
* fix(mnemopi): kept /tan clones from re-injecting the parent recall by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16338

name: Reasonix CLI v1.39.9
body:
> 修复只有思考内容的回复被当作完成、附加大文件让桌面服务退出、手动压缩后无法发送、流中途被截断的工具调用被当作完成、Studio 导入的会话在 1.x 里显示成多余会话、恢复出来的对话重复出现、恢复状态残留、目标模式工作时长一直为 0、! 命令找不到登录 shell 的程序、远程会话徽标，以及设置与模型实际能力不一致的问题。

**发布渠道：稳定版 · v1.39.9**

[English →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.9/?lang=en) · [网页版完整更新日志 →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.9/)

## 概览

**Reasonix v1.39.9 — Reasonix 1.39.9**

修复只有思考内容的回复被当作完成、附加大文件让桌面服务退出、手动压缩后无法发送、流中途被截断的工具调用被当作完成、Studio 导入的会话在 1.x 里显示成多余会话、恢复出来的对话重复出现、恢复状态残留、目标模式工作时长一直为 0、! 命令找不到登录 shell 的程序、远程会话徽标，以及设置与模型实际能力不一致的问题。

发布日期：2026-10-20

**Desktop 14 · CLI 5**

## 桌面端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **只有思考内容的回复现在会重试一次，仍无答案时给出明确提示** — 有些模型只输出思考过程、没有答案也没有工具调用，这一轮却显示为已完成，你只会看到一行思考。现在会再请模型给出一次答案，已经取得的工具结果保留；如果仍然没有答案，这一轮会以明确的错误结束（支持英文、简体中文、繁体中文），说明没有产生答案，不再看起来像是完成了，重新打开会话时这条错误依然在。取消和各项上限的行为不变。导出的诊断信息还会增加不含内容的简短回复摘要（结束原因、大小、工具数量），方便反馈这类问题；它们不会进入模型上下文。 ([#13966](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13966) by @SivanCola)
- **[Desktop]** **附加超大文件不再让桌面服务退出** — 附加大文件（比如安装包、压缩包）可能让桌面服务退出，因为整份文件会先被读进内存并编码，之后才检查大小。现在文件选择、粘贴和拖入只要文件有路径，就直接按路径附加，不再复制一份；只以数据形式存在于页面里的文件（部分粘贴和拖入）会流式写入磁盘，不再整份放在内存里，每次上传的安全上限默认为 1 GiB，可以在你自己的 config.toml 里用 [attachments] max_stream_bytes 调整（设为 0 即取消上限），项目配置不能修改它。超过限制的文件会在读取之前被拒绝，提示里会写明文件名和限制。图片仍保持 64 MB 的限制。 ([#13543](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13543) by @SivanCola, [#12418](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12418) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop]** **手动压缩后可以继续发送，压缩阈值修改后立即生效** — 手动压缩对话之后，下一条消息可能被挡住、无法与模型沟通，现在已修复。在设置里修改压缩阈值会立即作用于正在打开的会话，不需要替换它；修改无关的偏好也不再重启会话的运行环境。已经在运行的子代理保持启动时的阈值，新建的子代理使用新值。会话因其他原因被替换时，你授予的项目之外文件夹的只读访问会原样保留，不会新增任何访问权限。 ([#12501](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12501) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop]** **会话的完整性索引文件丢失后，不再让所有会话打不开** — 每个附件或历史块旁边都有一个很小的完整性索引文件。如果这些索引文件丢失（比如清理之后，或被其他程序删除），而内容本身完好，所有会话都会因为传输错误而打不开。现在第一次读取时会从内容重建索引，并且只有内容和重建出的索引都与会话里记录的校验值一致才会接受；内容损坏时仍然拒绝。 ([#14018](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14018), [#14019](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14019) by @esengine)

### 修复

- **[Desktop]** **模型设置与各模型的实际能力一致，并保留你的默认值** — 选择图片理解模型时，现在会接受 Reasonix 已知能读图的模型（内置的或探测到的）；你明确停用的模型，或官方端点有限制的，仍会被拒绝。子代理的推理强度选项来自各模型自己的能力，过期的选择可以清除。你指定的规划模型即使与默认模型相同也会保持可见，选择「跟随对话模型」会清除这项指定。重命名连接或修改其他无关字段，不再重置它的默认模型和默认推理强度。 ([#14005](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14005) by @SivanCola)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **工具调用在流中途被截断时，不再被当作已完成的回答** — 使用 Responses 协议的模型，如果流在工具调用尚未完成时就结束，或带着格式错误的调用，以前可能被当作正常回答接受：这一轮只留下调用之前的文字，或者相邻的另一个调用被执行。现在这样的流会作为协议错误被拒绝，该次尝试里没有任何东西被执行，也不会存成最终回答。它不会自动重试，你可以自己继续对话。普通的纯文字回答和完整的调用不受影响。 ([#12526](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12526) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Studio 导入的会话不再在 1.x 里显示成多余的会话** — Studio 2.x 把它导入的会话以 v4-<id>.jsonl 的文件名写进项目的会话文件夹。1.x 之前会把这些文件当作普通会话、用文件名作标题列出来（有报告称多出 111 行），与它本来就有的对话重复。现在 1.x 把文件名以 v4- 开头的文件视为 Studio 的：不再列出，1.x 清理过期锁文件和租约文件时也不会碰它们。 ([#13444](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13444) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop]** **恢复出来的旧对话不再重复出现，也不再在侧栏里变换身份** — 更新之后，或会话列表在全新缓存上重建时，冲突恢复产生的副本可能被当成单独的对话列出来（有报告里 13 个对话变成 25 行）。现在后台检查完成后，已被其父会话覆盖的副本会重新隐藏。恢复出来的对话在内容校验或父会话被删除之后，也在侧栏里保持同一个身份；会话列表重建或退出时，不再等待一个已被替换的任务。不会改写你的任何会话文件。 ([#12822](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12822) by @esengine, [#13594](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13594) by @SivanCola)
- **[Desktop]** **导入重试成功后，恢复状态不再残留** — 旧会话因工作区冲突导入失败，之后重试（或重放一次已完成的导入）成功时，之前的恢复状态可能一直留着。现在一旦确认这次导入对应的正是那个来源、版本和目标，就会清除它；其他来源的失败仍保持待处理。这并不会找回从未导入过的会话。 ([#12503](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12503) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop]** **目标模式会显示累计的工作时长** — 一个已经自动进行了好几轮的目标，工作时长仍显示 0s。现在会累计在目标上实际工作的时间（暂停期间和应用关闭的时间不算），随会话保存，重启后仍会显示。这个数值不会提供给模型。 ([#12502](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12502) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop]** **以 ! 开头的命令能找到登录 shell 的 PATH 里的程序** — 从程序坞等启动器打开桌面应用时，它不会继承你在 .zshrc 或 .bashrc 里设置的登录 shell 的 PATH，所以用 ! 输入的命令找不到装在那里的工具。现在运行这类命令之前会读取登录 shell 的 PATH，并与继承来的 PATH 合并，保留原有项并去重；如果无法查询登录 shell，就像以前一样使用继承来的 PATH。 ([#13927](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13927) by @PeterHepta)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **远程会话也会显示未读圆点，切换会话不再出现误报的连接警告** — 远程会话现在和本地会话表现一致：后台的回复完成时会出现未读圆点，读过之后消失。后台会话完成或结束时会刷新会话列表，不论前台那个是否正在运行。普通的会话切换不再留下误报的连接警告，切走的会话迟到的回复也不会覆盖前台的状态，真实的连接失败仍然可见，连接恢复后会自行消除。要获得完整效果，需要同时更新远程的 Serve 和桌面应用；Serve 较旧时，圆点会退回按时间戳判断。 ([#11513](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11513) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链和网络库升级到已发布安全修复的版本** — Go 工具链升级到 1.26.9，golang.org/x/net 升级到 0.60.0（连同它要求的 golang.org/x 各模块），修复了漏洞扫描在这条线上报出的标准库和 x/net 的漏洞；升级之后，扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#12951](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12951) by @xxoingr)

## CLI 端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **只有思考内容的回复现在会重试一次，仍无答案时给出明确提示** — 有些模型只输出思考过程、没有答案也没有工具调用，这一轮却显示为已完成，你只会看到一行思考。现在会再请模型给出一次答案，已经取得的工具结果保留；如果仍然没有答案，这一轮会以明确的错误结束（支持英文、简体中文、繁体中文），说明没有产生答案，不再看起来像是完成了，重新打开会话时这条错误依然在。取消和各项上限的行为不变。导出的诊断信息还会增加不含内容的简短回复摘要（结束原因、大小、工具数量），方便反馈这类问题；它们不会进入模型上下文。 ([#13966](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13966) by @SivanCola)

### 修复

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **工具调用在流中途被截断时，不再被当作已完成的回答** — 使用 Responses 协议的模型，如果流在工具调用尚未完成时就结束，或带着格式错误的调用，以前可能被当作正常回答接受：这一轮只留下调用之前的文字，或者相邻的另一个调用被执行。现在这样的流会作为协议错误被拒绝，该次尝试里没有任何东西被执行，也不会存成最终回答。它不会自动重试，你可以自己继续对话。普通的纯文字回答和完整的调用不受影响。 ([#12526](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12526) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Studio 导入的会话不再在 1.x 里显示成多余的会话** — Studio 2.x 把它导入的会话以 v4-<id>.jsonl 的文件名写进项目的会话文件夹。1.x 之前会把这些文件当作普通会话、用文件名作标题列出来（有报告称多出 111 行），与它本来就有的对话重复。现在 1.x 把文件名以 v4- 开头的文件视为 Studio 的：不再列出，1.x 清理过期锁文件和租约文件时也不会碰它们。 ([#13444](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13444) by @esengine)

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链和网络库升级到已发布安全修复的版本** — Go 工具链升级到 1.26.9，golang.org/x/net 升级到 0.60.0（连同它要求的 golang.org/x 各模块），修复了漏洞扫描在这条线上报出的标准库和 x/net 的漏洞；升级之后，扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#12951](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12951) by @xxoingr)

## 升级提醒

本版本无需手动迁移。

## 风险提示

- **[Desktop]** **恢复组在侧栏里的标识可能变化一次** — 修复旧缓存里没有主题标识的恢复对话组的身份时，该组的标识可能变化一次。你的会话文件里显式写下的标识以及文件本身都不会被改动。 ([#13594](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13594) by @SivanCola)

## 下载与安装

- [查看完整差异](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/desktop-v1.39.8...desktop-v1.39.9)

## 贡献者

- **[Desktop]** **会话的完整性索引文件丢失后，不再让所有会话打不开** — 每个附件或历史块旁边都有一个很小的完整性索引文件。如果这些索引文件丢失（比如清理之后，或被其他程序删除），而内容本身完好，所有会话都会因为传输错误而打不开。现在第一次读取时会从内容重建索引，并且只有内容和重建出的索引都与会话里记录的校验值一致才会接受；内容损坏时仍然拒绝。 ([#14018](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14018), [#14019](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14019) by @esengine)

### 修复

- **[Desktop]** **模型设置与各模型的实际能力一致，并保留你的默认值** — 选择图片理解模型时，现在会接受 Reasonix 已知能读图的模型（内置的或探测到的）；你明确停用的模型，或官方端点有限制的，仍会被拒绝。子代理的推理强度选项来自各模型自己的能力，过期的选择可以清除。你指定的规划模型即使与默认模型相同也会保持可见，选择「跟随对话模型」会清除这项指定。重命名连接或修改其他无关字段，不再重置它的默认模型和默认推理强度。 ([#14005](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14005) by @SivanCola)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **工具调用在流中途被截断时，不再被当作已完成的回答** — 使用 Responses 协议的模型，如果流在工具调用尚未完成时就结束，或带着格式错误的调用，以前可能被当作正常回答接受：这一轮只留下调用之前的文字，或者相邻的另一个调用被执行。现在这样的流会作为协议错误被拒绝，该次尝试里没有任何东西被执行，也不会存成最终回答。它不会自动重试，你可以自己继续对话。普通的纯文字回答和完整的调用不受影响。 ([#12526](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12526) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Studio 导入的会话不再在 1.x 里显示成多余的会话** — Studio 2.x 把它导入的会话以 v4-<id>.jsonl 的文件名写进项目的会话文件夹。1.x 之前会把这些文件当作普通会话、用文件名作标题列出来（有报告称多出 111 行），与它本来就有的对话重复。现在 1.x 把文件名以 v4- 开头的文件视为 Studio 的：不再列出，1.x 清理过期锁文件和租约文件时也不会碰它们。 ([#13444](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13444) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop]** **恢复出来的旧对话不再重复出现，也不再在侧栏里变换身份** — 更新之后，或会话列表在全新缓存上重建时，冲突恢复产生的副本可能被当成单独的对话列出来（有报告里 13 个对话变成 25 行）。现在后台检查完成后，已被其父会话覆盖的副本会重新隐藏。恢复出来的对话在内容校验或父会话被删除之后，也在侧栏里保持同一个身份；会话列表重建或退出时，不再等待一个已被替换的任务。不会改写你的任何会话文件。 ([#12822](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12822) by @esengine, [#13594](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13594) by @SivanCola)
- **[Desktop]** **导入重试成功后，恢复状态不再残留** — 旧会话因工作区冲突导入失败，之后重试（或重放一次已完成的导入）成功时，之前的恢复状态可能一直留着。现在一旦确认这次导入对应的正是那个来源、版本和目标，就会清除它；其他来源的失败仍保持待处理。这并不会找回从未导入过的会话。 ([#12503](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12503) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop]** **目标模式会显示累计的工作时长** — 一个已经自动进行了好几轮的目标，工作时长仍显示 0s。现在会累计在目标上实际工作的时间（暂停期间和应用关闭的时间不算），随会话保存，重启后仍会显示。这个数值不会提供给模型。 ([#12502](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12502) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop]** **以 ! 开头的命令能找到登录 shell 的 PATH 里的程序** — 从程序坞等启动器打开桌面应用时，它不会继承你在 .zshrc 或 .bashrc 里设置的登录 shell 的 PATH，所以用 ! 输入的命令找不到装在那里的工具。现在运行这类命令之前会读取登录 shell 的 PATH，并与继承来的 PATH 合并，保留原有项并去重；如果无法查询登录 shell，就像以前一样使用继承来的 PATH。 ([#13927](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13927) by @PeterHepta)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **远程会话也会显示未读圆点，切换会话不再出现误报的连接警告** — 远程会话现在和本地会话表现一致：后台的回复完成时会出现未读圆点，读过之后消失。后台会话完成或结束时会刷新会话列表，不论前台那个是否正在运行。普通的会话切换不再留下误报的连接警告，切走的会话迟到的回复也不会覆盖前台的状态，真实的连接失败仍然可见，连接恢复后会自行消除。要获得完整效果，需要同时更新远程的 Serve 和桌面应用；Serve 较旧时，圆点会退回按时间戳判断。 ([#11513](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11513) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链和网络库升级到已发布安全修复的版本** — Go 工具链升级到 1.26.9，golang.org/x/net 升级到 0.60.0（连同它要求的 golang.org/x 各模块），修复了漏洞扫描在这条线上报出的标准库和 x/net 的漏洞；升级之后，扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#12951](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12951) by @xxoingr)

## CLI 端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **只有思考内容的回复现在会重试一次，仍无答案时给出明确提示** — 有些模型只输出思考过程、没有答案也没有工具调用，这一轮却显示为已完成，你只会看到一行思考。现在会再请模型给出一次答案，已经取得的工具结果保留；如果仍然没有答案，这一轮会以明确的错误结束（支持英文、简体中文、繁体中文），说明没有产生答案，不再看起来像是完成了，重新打开会话时这条错误依然在。取消和各项上限的行为不变。导出的诊断信息还会增加不含内容的简短回复摘要（结束原因、大小、工具数量），方便反馈这类问题；它们不会进入模型上下文。 ([#13966](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13966) by @SivanCola)

### 修复

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **工具调用在流中途被截断时，不再被当作已完成的回答** — 使用 Responses 协议的模型，如果流在工具调用尚未完成时就结束，或带着格式错误的调用，以前可能被当作正常回答接受：这一轮只留下调用之前的文字，或者相邻的另一个调用被执行。现在这样的流会作为协议错误被拒绝，该次尝试里没有任何东西被执行，也不会存成最终回答。它不会自动重试，你可以自己继续对话。普通的纯文字回答和完整的调用不受影响。 ([#12526](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12526) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Studio 导入的会话不再在 1.x 里显示成多余的会话** — Studio 2.x 把它导入的会话以 v4-<id>.jsonl 的文件名写进项目的会话文件夹。1.x 之前会把这些文件当作普通会话、用文件名作标题列出来（有报告称多出 111 行），与它本来就有的对话重复。现在 1.x 把文件名以 v4- 开头的文件视为 Studio 的：不再列出，1.x 清理过期锁文件和租约文件时也不会碰它们。 ([#13444](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13444) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **远程会话也会显示未读圆点，切换会话不再出现误报的连接警告** — 远程会话现在和本地会话表现一致：后台的回复完成时会出现未读圆点，读过之后消失。后台会话完成或结束时会刷新会话列表，不论前台那个是否正在运行。普通的会话切换不再留下误报的连接警告，切走的会话迟到的回复也不会覆盖前台的状态，真实的连接失败仍然可见，连接恢复后会自行消除。要获得完整效果，需要同时更新远程的 Serve 和桌面应用；Serve 较旧时，圆点会退回按时间戳判断。 ([#11513](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11513) by @XTLine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链和网络库升级到已发布安全修复的版本** — Go 工具链升级到 1.26.9，golang.org/x/net 升级到 0.60.0（连同它要求的 golang.org/x 各模块），修复了漏洞扫描在这条线上报出的标准库和 x/net 的漏洞；升级之后，扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#12951](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12951) by @xxoingr)

## 升级提醒

本版本无需手动迁移。

## 风险提示

- **[Desktop]** **恢复组在侧栏里的标识可能变化一次** — 修复旧缓存里没有主题标识的恢复对话组的身份时，该组的标识可能变化一次。你的会话文件里显式写下的标识以及文件本身都不会被改动。 ([#13594](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/13594) by @SivanCola)

name: Reasonix Studio v2.46.0
body:
本版新增会话级 Agent 预设（默认关闭）、终端排队消息管理、设置里独立的“会话间消息”、项目内 `.reasonix/reasonix.toml`，长会话占用的内存明显降低，并修复公网远程误报离线、多标签页掉帧、macOS 托盘图标、1.x 会话导入等一批问题。

## 新增

- 新增会话级 Agent 预设：人设、工具和模块按会话绑定版本，在人设页管理，输入框上方的状态行里选择；默认不启用，选择器默认隐藏，可在人设页开启。关联 #13613 by @SivanCola。
- 预设只能调整 MCP 和扩展的超时，不能改写启动参数、地址或凭据；写预设和切换组合需要配置编辑授权；跨项目移动已绑定的会话会被拒绝，原会话保持不变。关联 #13613 by @SivanCola。
- 终端里排队的消息画在工作行下：↑ 选中修改，Alt+↑/↓ 调序，Enter 保存，连按两次 d 删除，r 重试，空格暂停。关联 #12144。
- 设置里的“会话间消息”成为独立的一项，可以从已添加的项目里选择放行、一键撤销。关联 #13794。
- 提问卡片的自由填写框也能“优化提示词”：点星标或按 Ctrl+Shift+E，改写只在你点“采用”后才替换。关联 #13870。
- 关联电脑到账号时多一个默认勾选的“加入贡献榜”，旁边显示将公开的名字，点“确认”才生效；终端关联后也会提示加入命令。关联 #13142。
- 发送反馈时附上各进程的内存（只有进程类型和数字），表单里能先看到，方便判断是界面还是内核占得多。关联 #13899。
- Studio 项目配置支持 `.reasonix/reasonix.toml`，仅在根目录的 `reasonix.toml` 不存在时使用，项目权限限制不变。关联 #6007 fixed in #13887 by @lancy69。

## 变更

- 长会话占用的内存更少：已完成的长输出在页面里只保留开头和结尾各 4 KB，可点“显示完整输出”取回；命令运行期间只保留最近 64 KB。关联 #13899。
- 已完成的子代理卡片收起时不再加载它的子调用，展开才加载；120 个子代理的页面节点从约 5 万降到约 5 千。关联 #13899。
- 技能子代理（explore、locate 等）在子代理列表里除了名字，也显示它收到的任务的第一行。关联 #13458。
- 模型派任务给尚未决定信任的项目时，对方窗口保持打开并显示信任问题，并告知任务未发送；后台窗格在等你决定信任时，侧栏会话行也会标出来。关联 #13681、#13890。

## 修复

- 公网远程时，较大的历史或文件传输超过半分钟会被误报“请检查电脑是否在线”；现在电脑仍在回传就继续等。关联 #13909。
- 打开两个及以上标签页时，展开或收起左侧会话栏会掉帧；现在隐藏的标签页不再参与重排。关联 #13936 fixed in #13937。
- macOS 菜单栏里的托盘图标不再是整个彩色应用图标，改为随浅色、深色菜单栏着色的单色图标。关联 #13929 fixed in #13930。
- 长时间使用后偶发“缺少本次启动的凭据，请重新打开 Studio 后重试”、发送按钮失效；外壳现在会在认证 cookie 被移除时立即补回，并在日志里记下原因。关联 #13932。
- 恢复旧会话时，1.x 桌面端自己新建的、编号带 desktop- 或 desktop-manual- 前缀的会话不再被跳过；1.x 里已归档的会话迁移后仍是归档。关联 #13920 fixed in #13921、#13880 by @imcreazy。
- 会话很多时点开“归档”，读取期间不再显示“没有匹配的会话”，改为“正在读取文件夹…”。关联 #13884。
- 工作区很大（如整个盘根）时，首个工具最多等待 10 秒的工作区快照，超时记为观察不完整，不再一直卡住。关联 #13883。
- 侧栏会话行的标题不再被过早截断：不再为没显示的按钮留空位，归档按钮只在悬停或聚焦时占位。关联 #13904 fixed in #13908。
- 显示左侧图标栏时，侧栏底部的“连接与机器”不再重复出现。关联 #13916。
- 历史索引遇到暂时读不了的会话文件后，会在它恢复可读时重新索引，不再一直显示“正在建立索引”。关联 #13923 by @chuiwenwei。
- 代码模式的脚本里 `read_file` 现在返回文件原文，不再把带行号的显示形式写回文件造成污染。关联 #13945 by @SivanCola。
- 压缩失败（摘要被截断或拒绝）后不再把日期、技能列表、项目说明重复发给模型，提示不再越滚越大。关联 #13949 by @SivanCola。
- 根目录忽略规则里以转义的 `!` 或 `#` 开头的模式、以及 `core.excludesFile` 的读取方式，现在和 git 一致。关联 #13907 by @kevin9327、#13906 by @kevin9327。
- 记忆迁移遇到读不了的条目时会如实报告而不是中途停止；还原归档时先暂存再发布，避免半途失败丢失。关联 #13912 by @chuiwenwei、#13905 by @chuiwenwei。
- 读取 OpenAI 兼容流里数字形式的错误码；合并工具进度和前后增量，展开游标跟随最新输出。关联 #13881 by @imcreazy、#13895 by @jf200s。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@lancy69、@imcreazy、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327、@jf200s

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds session Agent presets (off by default), terminal queue management, a Session messages entry in Settings and `.reasonix/reasonix.toml`.
Long sessions use much less memory, and it fixes false offline reports over the relay, dropped frames with several tabs, the macOS tray icon and 1.x session import.

## New

- Session Agent presets: personas, tools and modules are bound to a session by version, managed on the Persona page. Off by default; the picker stays hidden until you turn it on. Refs #13613 by @SivanCola.
- Presets may adjust only MCP and extension timeouts, never launch arguments, endpoints or credentials. Writing presets and switching need configuration-edit authority. Refs #13613 by @SivanCola.
- Moving a conversation bound to a preset into another project is refused, and the original stays unchanged. Refs #13613 by @SivanCola.
- In the terminal, queued messages show under the working line: Up selects, Alt+Up/Down reorders, Enter saves, d twice deletes, r retries, Space pauses. Refs #12144.
- Session messages is its own entry in Settings, where projects can be allowed through from those already added or taken back. Refs #13794.
- The free-text box of a question card can optimise the prompt: click the sparkle or press Ctrl+Shift+E; the rewrite replaces your text only when you take it. Refs #13870.
- Linking a computer offers a pre-ticked "join the contribution board" with the public name, applied only on Confirm; the terminal prints the join command. Refs #13142.
- A report now carries each process's memory (only the process type and numbers), shown in the form first, to tell the interface from the kernel. Refs #13899.
- Studio loads `.reasonix/reasonix.toml` when the root `reasonix.toml` is absent, with unchanged project restrictions. Refs #6007 fixed in #13887 by @lancy69.

## Changed

- Long sessions use less memory: a finished call's long output keeps its first and last 4 KB, with "Show full output" to fetch the rest; a running command keeps its last 64 KB. Refs #13899.
- A closed, finished sub-agent no longer holds its child calls in the page; 120 sub-agents drop from about 50,000 nodes to 5,000. Refs #13899.
- A skill sub-agent (explore, locate and the like) shows the first line of its task in the sub-agent list beside its name. Refs #13458.
- Dispatching to a project you have not yet trusted keeps its window open with the trust question and says the task was not sent. Refs #13681.
- A background pane asking whether to trust its folder is marked in the sidebar like any other waiting one. Refs #13890.

## Fixed

- Over the public relay, a history or file taking over 30 seconds to arrive was reported as "check the computer is online"; it is now waited for. Refs #13909.
- With two or more tabs open, folding the left session rail dropped frames; hidden tabs no longer take part in that relayout. Refs #13936 fixed in #13937.
- On macOS the menu-bar tray icon is a monochrome template glyph that follows the light or dark bar, not the full-colour app badge. Refs #13929 fixed in #13930.
- The occasional "this launch's credential is missing" refusal after long use, with a dead send button: the shell now restores its authentication cookie if it is removed and logs the cause. Refs #13932.
- Recovering older sessions no longer skips the conversations 1.x Desktop created itself (ids prefixed desktop- or desktop-manual-), and sessions 1.x had archived stay archived. Refs #13920 fixed in #13921, #13880 by @imcreazy.
- With a long history, Archived no longer says "No matching sessions" while still reading; it says it is reading. Refs #13884.
- In a very large workspace (a drive root, say) the first tool waits at most 10 s for the workspace snapshot and records the observation as incomplete. Refs #13883.
- Session titles in the sidebar are no longer cut short: nothing is held back for buttons that are not showing, and the archive button takes room only while hovered or focused. Refs #13904 fixed in #13908.
- The sidebar's "Connections and machines" button no longer repeats the Remote entry of the icon rail while the rail is shown. Refs #13916.
- After a session file was briefly unreadable, the history index retries it once it can be read, instead of staying at "still building". Refs #13923 by @chuiwenwei.
- In code mode, a script's `read_file` returns the file's text, so a read-edit-write script no longer writes the numbered display back into the file. Refs #13945 by @SivanCola.
- After a failed compaction (a truncated or refused summary), the date, skills listing and project instructions are no longer sent to the model again, so the prompt stops growing. Refs #13949 by @SivanCola.
- An escaped leading `!` or `#` in root ignore patterns, and how `core.excludesFile` is read, now follow git. Refs #13907 by @kevin9327, #13906 by @kevin9327.
- A memory migration reports an entry it cannot read instead of stopping; archive restores stage before publishing. Refs #13912 by @chuiwenwei, #13905 by @chuiwenwei.
- A numeric error code in an OpenAI-compatible stream error is read; tool progress merges with the deltas around it, and the reveal cursor follows the latest output. Refs #13881 by @imcreazy, #13895 by @jf200s.

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @lancy69, @imcreazy, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327, @jf200s

name: Open Design 0.26.0 — Share, Review, Refine
body:
### 🌟 Codename: *Share, Review, Refine*

🔗 **The work can leave the project—and the feedback can find its way home.** Share an interactive design or motion video with the people who need to review it; let them watch, try it, and comment in context. Then choose the feedback that matters, send it to an Agent, and keep the review connected to the next round of making.

## 🔥 Highlights

- 🎞️ **Motion Design—make the idea move.** Motion Design now appears on Home and in Community, with curated helpers and examples. Start from an editable source, create motion for a video brief, and export an MP4 when the work needs to travel. (#8619)
- 🔗 **One link for the team and the client.** Copy a work link and send it out: signed-in reviewers can view and try the work in a browser, without installing the desktop app. Motion videos can travel the same way. The shared page shows the work preview and its comments—not the project's AI conversations or code view. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- 💬 **Comment on the part that needs changing.** Select the place in the work that needs attention and leave a comment such as “make this title stand out” or “change this button color.” Everyone sees the same feedback on the same page, with less screenshot markup and fewer clarification loops. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- 🤖 **Bring feedback back to the project—and hand the revision to an Agent.** Comments sync into Open Design. Select the feedback to act on, send it to an Agent, then review the result before the next pass. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- 🔄 **Update the work, not the link.** After a revision, manually refresh the shared content and reviewers can keep using the same URL. They see that a newer version is available and can refresh to view it; end the share whenever the review is done. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- 🧩 **Plugins stay attached to the work you send.** Applying a plugin in an existing project now preserves its selected snapshot and respects the capabilities you already granted. (#7597) Thanks @lorenzozanee.
- 🧠 **Bring the model you actually use.** During BYOK onboarding, enter a custom model instead of being limited to the suggested list—useful for local Ollama, self-hosted endpoints, and newer models. (#6076) Thanks @dpeterson01.
- 🌀 **A stuck chat can find its way back.** When a chat log stops following its layout, Open Design recovers scrolling and keeps wheel and keyboard navigation available. (#8251) Thanks @lefarcen.
- 🖼️ **Finished work shows up where you expect it.** After a run creates an image or file, Open Design refreshes its snapshot and opens the result by the existing rules—without taking over a preview you selected yourself. (#8744)

> 📥 **Download:** Tag `open-design-v0.26.0`.
>
> | Platform | Architecture | Assets |
> |---|---|---|
> | macOS | Apple silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-mac-arm64.dmg) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-mac-arm64.dmg.sha256) |
> | macOS | Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-mac-x64.dmg) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-mac-x64.dmg.sha256) |
> | Windows | x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-win-x64-setup.exe) · [SHA-256](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/releases/download/open-design-v0.26.0/open-design-0.26.0-win-x64-setup.exe.sha256) |

## ✨ Added

### 🎨 Studio, editing and canvas

- Motion Design adds curated skills, bundled examples, editable sources, and MP4 production for video-oriented work. (#8619)

### 🔑 Models and plugins

- BYOK onboarding accepts custom model names alongside the built-in suggestions. (#6076) Thanks @dpeterson01.
- Existing projects retain the plugin snapshot and granted capabilities chosen for an apply. (#7597) Thanks @lorenzozanee.

## 🐛 Fixed

### 🤝 Sharing and collaboration

- Signed-in reviewers can view and interact with shared work or motion video in the browser; shared pages intentionally keep project AI conversations and code views private. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- Contextual comments sync back to the project, where selected feedback can be sent to an Agent for the next revision. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- A shared work link stays stable across manually refreshed revisions and can be stopped when the review is complete. (#8408) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- Existing cloud file identities and aliases are recovered before publishing, so resumed or updated shares keep their original links when local mappings are missing. (#8859, #8867) Thanks @alchemistklk.
- Uploading duplicate filenames in one batch keeps names and contents in submission order. (#8742)

### 🧠 Agents, runs and Home

- Home keeps a draft blocked when funding confirmation is insufficient or unknown; billing changes refresh the hint without sending that draft for you. (#8688, #8775, #8786)
- The default AMR model is resolved from the caller's available catalog, avoiding an avoidable first-run failure. (#8519) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- Cached offline content now respects revocation and expiry across restarts. (#8676)

### 🖥️ Desktop and workspace

- Workspace users can complete the desktop update safety check without an unscoped active-run request blocking restart. (#8462) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- A saved empty local file selection survives restore instead of being replaced by a default artifact. (#8745) Thanks @open-design-crew.

## 🙏 Thanks to everyone who shipped 0.26.0

@alchemistklk · @hihicheems · @Siri-Ray · @dpeterson01 · @lefarcen · @lorenzozanee

# oh-my-codex v0.21.26

`0.21.26` is a patch release for team dispatch state isolation and performance improvements (6 commits, 19 files, +722/−269; PRs #3859, #3862, #3863).

## Highlights

- **Team dispatch state isolation (#3862):** The team dispatch recovery system now isolates degraded observations from authoritative runtime projections, preventing stale state from contaminating recovery paths:
  1. Fallback request isolation: Fallback requests, retries, and delivery observations are stored in each Team's dispatch directory, preventing TypeScript writers from overwriting shared runtime projections.
  2. Fresh state on retry: The merged dispatch reader supplements authoritative state only with proven local fallback requests or durable finalization receipts, ensuring recovery does not reinject stale requests.
  3. Lifecycle preservation: Retry counts and local reasons are preserved after runtime transitions, while authoritative lifecycle timestamps and foreign-Team isolation remain intact. Authored by @shenyankm.

- **Dispatch identity ledger optimization (#3863):** The dispatch identity ledger (`dispatch-seen.json`) is now loaded once per merge instead of per fallback request, reducing file I/O from O(fallbacks) reads to a single read and O(fallbacks) lookups. This improves team mailbox efficiency, especially with high fallback counts. Authored by @Yeachan-Heo.

## Compatibility

- Team dispatch recovery now uses fresh fallback state instead of stale observations; recovery behavior may differ for edge cases involving runtime bridge failures and local fallbacks.
- Existing dispatch records and team delivery state remain compatible.
- The team delivery state contract has been updated to reflect the new state isolation semantics.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `8910439aa4598f1a4e9819b45e11934b0116ab06` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
- Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
- All code review findings addressed.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.25

`0.21.25` is a patch release for team mailbox isolation hardening (2 commits, 3 files, +205/−4; PR #3857).

## Highlights

- **Team mailbox isolation hardening (#3857):** The team delivery system now fails closed on unconfirmed mailbox creation, rejecting runtime state, persistence, timeout, and invalid acknowledgement failures instead of publishing a successful JSON-only fallback:
  1. Fail-closed behavior on creation failure: Runtime rejections, persistence failures, timeouts, and invalid acknowledgements no longer produce a JSON-only mailbox record.
  2. Partial event reconciliation: Partially persisted creation events are reconciled before assigning another ID, preventing duplicate mailbox IDs within a team scope.
  3. Deduplication across refresh races: The same verified projection is used across refresh races to prevent concurrent creation races from producing multiple mailboxes for the same request. Authored by @shenyankm with @gaebal-gajae.

## Compatibility

- Team mailbox creation now fails when runtime confirmation fails; existing integrations must handle creation failures gracefully.
- Existing delivered mailboxes and team dispatch records remain compatible.
- The team delivery state contract has been updated to reflect the new fail-closed semantics.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `9aa3e7066291a47d1427ad274ed47e0511712ee7` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 18 checks succeeded and 7 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.24

`0.21.24` is a patch release for setup plugin-cache repair hardening (9 commits, 5 files, +365/−28; PRs #3851, #3852, #3853, #3854).

## Highlights

- **Repair safety hardening (#3851, #3853, #3854):** The setup repair command now enforces stricter requirements on plugin cache removal, preventing false-safe recommendations for live-pinned or unverified caches:
  1. Mandatory `removalSafe` field validation in dry-run mode, failing closed when safety cannot be verified.
  2. `removalSafe` derived only from verified managed+unpinned cache eligibility.
  3. Idempotent dry-run behavior returning `unchanged` for identical caches, matching actual repair behavior. Authored by @Yeachan-Heo.

- **Late-pin scenario test coverage (#3849):** Comprehensive removalSafe field tests validate hardening logic against edge cases in pinned-cache handling. Authored by @Yeachan-Heo.

- **Session state gitignore (#3852):** The .gitignore now excludes gjc runtime session state to reduce noise in untracked-file listings. Authored by @Yeachan-Heo.

## Compatibility

- `omx setup --plugin --repair-plugin-cache` behavior is unchanged for valid recovery scenarios; only safety validation and edge-case guidance is improved.
- Existing task records, plugin configurations, and DAG flags remain compatible.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.23

`0.21.23` is a patch release for evidence requirements in generated team tasks and non-directory plugin cache recovery guidance (5 commits, 14 files, +914/−58; PRs #3840, #3846).

## Highlights

- **Evidence requirements for generated team tasks (#3840):** Generated team tasks now default to requiring evidence that code changes address the intent, unless the task is explicitly marked as analysis, reporting, or read-only. Task decomposition shares intent classification across CLI and DAG planning to preserve analysis context while requiring evidence for implementation requests. Authored by @shenyankm.

- **Non-directory plugin cache recovery guidance (#3846):** Extend cache recovery guidance to cover non-directory entries (symlinks and other non-directory types) in the plugin cache alongside existing pinned-snapshot handling. The repair command continues to emit fail-closed guidance when safe recovery options cannot be determined. Authored by @Yeachan-Heo.

## Compatibility

- Team task evidence requirements follow existing completion gates; generated tasks must provide evidence to match manual task contracts.
- `omx setup --plugin --repair-plugin-cache` behavior is unchanged for valid recovery scenarios; only guidance for unsafe entries is improved.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.22

`0.21.22` is a patch release for fail-closed cache recovery guidance in setup repair (3 commits, 13 files, +178/−28; PR #3842).

## Highlights

- **Fail-closed cache recovery guidance (#3842):** Fix `omx setup --plugin --repair-plugin-cache` to avoid recommending users delete plugin snapshots pinned by live Codex sessions or entries that are not directories. The repair command now emits fail-closed guidance directing users to safe recovery options instead of potentially destructive removal suggestions.

## Compatibility

- `omx setup --plugin --repair-plugin-cache` behavior is unchanged for valid recovery scenarios; only the guidance for unsafe snapshots is improved.
- Existing configurations remain compatible; no changes required.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `012672fa9d4995319d424c2ba9286e593d169047` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
- Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
- All code review findings resolved.

## Merged PR inventory

| PR | Author | Title |
|---|---|---|
| [#3842](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/pull/3842) | @gajae-gajae | test: add failing tests for fail-closed cache recovery guidance |

## Documentation corrections

- Corrected v0.21.21 release range stats from (10 files, +190/−128) to accurate (7 files, +174/−104).

## Contributors

Thanks to Bellman and gaebal-gajae for contributing to this release.

**Full Changelog**: [`v0.21.21...v0.21.22`](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex/compare/v0.21.21...v0.21.22)

—
*[repo owner's gaebal-gajae (clawdbot) 🦞]*
